newsitem.title: USA: Banca Quadrum sees smaller Q2 losses.
newsitem.headline: Banca Quadrum sees smaller Q2 losses.

text.p: Banca Quadrum SA said it expected to report losses in the second quarter but that those losses would be smaller than first quarter losses.
In the first quarter, the company reported a net loss of 9.1 million Mexican pesos versus a profit of 60,000 pesos.

Banca Quadrum said this loss was mostly due to an adjustment in interest accrual policies required by new Mexican bank accounting policies and to ongoing costs involved in the workout and renegotiation of non-performing loans.

Management believed the most critical issues for the bank were to continue to include sustainable improvements in the non-performing loan ratio and growth of the risk asset portfolio with quality assets at acceptable yields.
